layout_constraints.visual_motif: Original scoreboard strip plus two pitch cards connected by a speed-drop arrow.
layout_constraints.contrast_target: large light text on dark field with warm numeric accent

rights_boundaries.source_rights_caution: Use only original data-card graphics unless a real-source rights record is added later.

forbidden_avoid_claims: Do not imply this is real broadcast analysis.
Do not use official logos, player photos, or broadcast stills.
Do not call the pitch sequence a proven strategy outside the sample.
designer_note: Keep the thumbnail numeric and graphic-first: speed drop, pitch-type change, and low-outer target.
